name: claude-limit-guard
description: Watches Claude subscription usage limits; shows them in the status line, injects them into context, and gracefully saves/resumes work at a configurable threshold.

threshold.title: Usage threshold (%)
threshold.description: At or above this percentage the guard routine triggers (default 95).

warn_band.title: Warning band (%)
warn_band.description: At or above this percentage (but below the threshold) the status line turns amber (default 80).

threshold_five_hour.title: 5-hour window threshold (%)
threshold_five_hour.description: Override the guard threshold for the five_hour window only. Leave blank to use the global threshold.

threshold_seven_day.title: 7-day window threshold (%)
threshold_seven_day.description: Override the guard threshold for the seven_day window only. Leave blank to use the global threshold.

watch.title: Watched limit windows
watch.description: Comma-separated limit windows to show/guard, e.g. five_hour,seven_day (default five_hour,seven_day).

guard_action.title: Guard action at threshold
guard_action.description: What the AI should do when the threshold is reached. Leave empty for the built-in save-and-handoff routine.

warn_action.title: Warn action at warn band
warn_action.description: Gentle advice appended to context when utilization is in the warn band (below threshold, non-blocking). Leave empty for the built-in message.

label_style.title: Label style
label_style.description: How limit window labels appear in the status line: full (e.g. 'Limit session:') or short (e.g. '5h').

reset_display.title: Reset countdown display
reset_display.description: How the reset time appears: clock (e.g. '→ 06:00'), relative (e.g. '→ in 2h13m'), or both (e.g. '→ 06:00 (in 2h13m)').

projection_display.title: Burn-rate projection
projection_display.description: Show a projected time-to-threshold segment (e.g. '📈 ~1h40m to 90%') based on recent usage trend: off or on (default off).

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Pop up an OS notification once when a window enters the warn band or crosses the threshold: off or on (default off).
